items.definition:
a soft, silvery-white metallic chemical element
Cadmium is used in batteries and pigments.

a genus of yeasts, some species of which can cause infections in humans
Candida albicans is a common cause of yeast infections.

a thing that is hoped or wished for but in fact is illusory or impossible to achieve
The idea of a perfect society is often considered a chimera.

the shape or structure of something, especially an animal
The horse's conformation was excellent for racing.

baked clay, especially as used for pottery or building materials (often in 'terracotta')
The garden pot was made of terracotta.

political or military activities designed to prevent or thwart terrorism
The government has implemented new counterterrorism measures.

exemption from a rule or usual requirement
The church granted a special dispensation for the marriage.

a system of forced labor camps in the Soviet Union
Many political prisoners were sent to the Gulag during the Soviet era.

the state or quality of being immoral; wickedness
The book explored themes of morality and immorality.

a species of plant, especially Cannabis indica
Cannabis indica is known for its relaxing effects.

a person making an inquiry or investigation, especially one who is harsh or severe
The lawyer acted like an inquisitor during the cross-examination.

a person or thing that intercepts, especially an aircraft designed to intercept enemy aircraft
The fighter jet acted as an interceptor against the incoming missile.

an ancient eye cosmetic, traditionally made from powdered antimony or galena
Ancient Egyptians used kohl to line their eyes.

A collection of wild animals kept in captivity for exhibition
The eccentric millionaire kept a strange menagerie of exotic birds.

A hypothetical set of multiple possible universes
The theory suggests that our universe is just one of many in a vast multiverse.

A small group of people having control of a country or organization
The country was ruled by an oligarchy of wealthy families.

a person who is sexually attracted to children
The documentary discussed the psychological profile of a paedophile.

the apparent displacement of an observed object due to a change in the observer's position
Astronomers use parallax to measure the distance to nearby stars.

a body of troops or police officers standing or moving in close formation
The ancient Greek phalanx was a formidable military formation.

the process of reacting monomer molecules together in a chemical reaction to form polymer chains
The polymerization process is crucial in plastic manufacturing.

the pouch of skin containing the testicles
The doctor examined the patient's scrotum.

a place where ore is smelted
The new smelter will increase metal production.

the quality of being spontaneous
They loved the spontaneity of their road trips.

the action of twisting or the state of being twisted
Engineers calculated the torsion on the bridge's support beams.

nonsense (British informal)
Don't listen to his advice, it's all tosh.

a standard or criterion by which something is judged
The novel became a touchstone for modern literature.

A type of entertainment popular in the early 20th century.
Vaudeville shows often featured a variety of acts.

Enthusiasm or vigor.
She performed the dance with great verve.

The shape of a wave.
The oscilloscope displayed the audio waveform.

a part of the brain involved in emotion
The amygdala plays a key role in processing fear.

a professional entertainer, especially a singer or dancer
The circus featured a talented artiste who performed amazing acrobatics.

a place or state of affairs considered to be backward and isolated
The small village was considered a cultural backwater.

a legacy; something left to someone in a will
She received a generous bequest from her grandmother's will.

a measurable indicator of the severity or presence of some disease state
Scientists are searching for new biomarkers to detect cancer early.

the production of complex molecules within living organisms or cells
Photosynthesis is a crucial process of biosynthesis in plants.

a ridge or keel-like structure, especially the point where the trachea divides into the two main bronchi
The carina is a sensitive area in the respiratory tract.

a gradation in one or more characteristics within a species or other group, especially between populations in different areas
There is a genetic cline in the bird population across the continent.

a particle accelerator in which two beams of particles are made to collide
The Large Hadron Collider is used to study subatomic particles.

ruthless competitor
The business world can be a cutthroat.

study of population statistics
Demography is crucial for understanding population trends.

separation, detachment
She experienced a feeling of dissociation from her body during the trauma.

unusual behavior
His eccentricity made him stand out in the crowd.

messenger, representative
The king sent an emissary to negotiate peace.

act of trapping or tricking
The defense lawyer argued that his client was a victim of entrapment.

point of ignition; critical point
The disputed territory became a flashpoint for conflict.

the branch of medicine dealing with women's health, especially the reproductive system
She decided to specialize in gynecology after medical school.

the joint in the hind leg of a horse or other quadruped, corresponding to the human ankle
The horse injured its hock during the race.

Dislike of or prejudice against Islam or Muslims.
The rise of Islamophobia is a serious concern.

The secretion of milk by the mammary glands.
Lactation is a natural process for mammals.

The removal or loosening of restrictions, typically on economic or political matters.
The liberalization of trade policies led to increased imports.

A general feeling of discomfort, illness, or uneasiness whose exact cause is difficult to identify.
She experienced a general malaise before the flu symptoms appeared.

a highly flammable sticky jelly used in incendiary bombs and flamethrowers
The use of napalm in warfare caused widespread international condemnation.

surgery performed on the nervous system, especially the brain and spinal cord
He underwent complex neurosurgery to remove the tumor.

a subatomic particle with a very small mass and no electric charge
Neutrinos are notoriously difficult to detect due to their weak interaction with matter.

adult film actor
The documentary explored the life of a former pornstar.

ancestor, originator
The company's founder is considered the progenitor of modern software development.

the act of measuring or counting something
The quantification of data is crucial for scientific research.

a type of edible fish
Fishermen often catch shad in the spring.

a chemical or biological agent, environmental condition, or external stimulus that causes stress to an organism
Lack of sleep can be a major stressor in daily life.

the quality of being based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions
The subjectivity of art makes it difficult to judge objectively.

a person or company that assesses and accepts risk for insurance policies
The underwriter reviewed the application for the new insurance policy.

a person who has risen suddenly in rank or importance, especially one who behaves arrogantly
He was dismissed as an upstart by the established members of the club.

a colorless crystalline compound that is the main nitrogenous end product of protein metabolism in mammals and is excreted in urine
Urea is a key component of fertilizer.

a character who struggles against the main character; a substance that initiates a physiological response
In the story, the protagonist and antagonist are clear, but the agonist is less defined.
